summary: Master the art of Cost-Benefit Analysis in our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools for informed financial decision-making.
lede: Cost-benefit analysis in financial decision making provides a structured way to compare costs, benefits, risks, and alternatives before recommending where resources should go. You will learn to identify direct and indirect costs, value tangible and intangible benefits, apply discounting logic, and use measures such as net present value and benefit-cost ratio to explain whether an initiative adds value. The course helps you turn incomplete data and competing priorities into a transparent decision process. Through practical worksheets, templates, Excel or Google Sheets exercises, sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, and recommendation slides, you will build and communicate evidence-based business cases with clearly documented assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course is aimed at professionals who evaluate investment requests, justify spending, and compare alternatives using financial evidence.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and basic financial statements; comfort using Excel or Google Sheets for calculations; and familiarity with project or investment proposals. No programming is required. Participants should be ready to work with simple discounting, cash flow estimates, and decision templates, and advanced valuation concepts will be introduced at an operational level rather than deep technical engineering level.
